summary.name: HeyMoon
summary.one_liner: HeyMoon.AI is a service that takes a store link and builds a creator marketing campaign around the products, with a guaranteed sales figure, priced in phases.
use_cases: launch a creator campaign for an online store
reach shoppers in UAE, Saudi Arabia and Kuwait
track creator sales through discount codes
scale a campaign in phases based on results
summary.what_it_does: HeyMoon reads a store's catalogue, prices, voice and target markets from a pasted store link. It then builds a full creator campaign, including markets, creators, budget and brief, and shows it before any payment. Each campaign comes with a written sales figure that HeyMoon says it covers if sales fall short. Campaigns run in phases: the first is $1,000 for every brand and later phases are offered only after the previous one reaches 80% of target. The page describes seven named agents handling intake, matching, safety, creative writing, activation, optimisation and learning. Store integrations listed are Salla, Zid, Shopify and Magento.
notable: Store link in, full campaign out: markets, creators, budget and brief priced before approval
Written sales guarantee per campaign, with HeyMoon covering any shortfall
Phased spend: $1,000, $4,000, $7,500, with next phase unlocked at 80% of target
Seven named AI agents for intake, matching, safety, creative, activation, optimisation and learning
caveats: Requires payment: first phase is $1,000 plus $50 VAT, with later phases at higher cost
Guarantee applies to campaigns; the page does not state terms beyond the written sales figure
Store integrations named are Salla, Zid, Shopify and Magento only
